expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are exact duplicates: same 'Green Bowl Poké' name, image, 15–25 min badge and €0.90 delivery fee. This looks like a data or rendering bug and wastes prime space on the most prominent carousel.
The secondary gray text ('€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light and small on a white background, so contrast is low. The placeholder text in the search bar is also faint.
The heart/favorite icon on the food images sits on a translucent dark circle over busy photos. The ramen card's circle is almost invisible, and the icon's contrast varies between cards.
The time badges on the carousel cards overlap the bottom-left edge of the image and look cramped. The white pill also sits close to the plate image.

Illustrated placeholder-style images (a generic bowl, a generic pizza) are used instead of real restaurant photos or logos. The cards also have no restaurant identity beyond the name, and the pizza card has a discount badge but no visible title yet.

expected.reasoning: Reported 0 describes the same duplicate Green Bowl Poké cards in the carousel.
